newsitem.title: USA: Centerior hires new Perry Nuclear chief.
newsitem.headline: Centerior hires new Perry Nuclear chief.

text.p: Centerior Energy Corp said Friday it has named Lew W. Myers as vice president - nuclear for the Perry Nuclear Power Plant.

Myers will assume his new position September 16, the company said. He has been plant manager for three years of Unit No. 1 of the two-unit South Texas Project, a nuclear facility operated by Houston Industries Inc's Houston Lighting & Power.
Myers will report to John Stetz, chief nuclear officer and senior vice president - nuclear. Stetz and Myers succeed Donald Shelton, who retired on August 30, 1996.
Shelton held both positions, Centerior noted.
